claims.evidence: The photo report shows the wardrobe but gives no wear indicators; age and usage history are not shown.
Dora the Explorer sticker on the left upper door indicates a children's item.
The report shows doors and handles but does not show a two-step mechanism.
A vertical mirror strip sits between the upper doors.
The report does not show the base, wheels, or tyres.

risks.risk: Doors and drawers may not open, close, or latch properly
risks.proof: A video clip showing every door and drawer being opened, closed, and latched.

risks.risk: Scratches, dents, or structural damage to the wood or trim
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all exterior panels, corners, edges, and the scalloped top trim.

risks.risk: Missing internal shelves or hanging rail
risks.proof: A photo of the wardrobe interior showing any shelves and the hanging rail.
risks.if_unproven: as an empty shell with no fittings

risks.risk: Exact height, width, and depth unknown
risks.proof: A photo showing a tape measure or the wardrobe next to a known object for scale.

risks.risk: Locks or keys may be missing
risks.proof: A photo of any locks and the matching keys.

risks.risk: Age and usage history may be much older or heavier than claimed
risks.proof: A purchase receipt or dated photos showing the wardrobe when acquired.

risks.risk: No wheels or tyres for easy movement
risks.proof: A photo of the base showing castors or tyres.

proof_requests: Video of all doors and drawers opening, closing, and latching
Close-up photos of exterior panels, corners, edges, and top trim
Interior photo showing shelves and hanging rail
Photo with tape measure or scale reference for dimensions
Photo of locks and keys if present
Photo of the base showing wheels or tyres
response.reason: The witness identifies a wooden wardrobe with visible doors, mirror strip, and stickers, so a worst-case price is possible even though condition, size, and fittings are unproven.
